name: ischool-ahly-judging-platform
description: iSchool x Al Ahly Club judging platform (local, offline).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors red,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:db: npm run build:shared && npm run test:db -w server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.db:check: npm run build:shared && npm run db:check -w server
scripts.db:setup: npm run build:shared && npm run db:setup -w server --
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w server --
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w server --
scripts.db:reset: npm run build:shared && npm run db:reset -w server --
scripts.db:app-user: npm run build:shared && npm run db:app-user -w server --
scripts.db:backup: npm run build:shared && npm run db:backup -w server --
scripts.db:restore: npm run build:shared && npm run db:restore -w server --
scripts.db:restore-check: npm run build:shared && npm run db:restore-check -w server --
scripts.auth:reset-password: npm run build:shared && npm run auth:reset-password -w server --
